description: This file defines an internal interface ICacheMetrics that specifies properties for collecting cache performance metrics, such as hit ratio, total requests, hits, misses, evictions, and updates within the Orleans caching system.

methods.name: HitRatio
methods.description: Returns the ratio of cache hits to total requests, indicating cache efficiency.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Returns the total number of cache requests made.

methods.name: Hits
methods.description: Returns the total number of cache hits.

methods.name: Misses
methods.description: Returns the total number of cache misses.

methods.name: Evicted
methods.description: Returns the total number of evicted items.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Returns the total number of updated cache items.
